Widgets
A GPS fix is used on your phone and only your location rounded to about 1 km is sent to Open-Meteo to get the forecast and air quality. City search sends the name you type to Open-Meteo, naming your current place sends approximate coordinates to BigDataCloud (with location off, BigDataCloud is asked for the approximate place of your network connection instead), and search suggestions (when on) send what you type to Google. Your exact position is never saved, and not included in backups.
Weather effects
Rain, snow, storms with lightning, fog, clouds, sun and stars move over your wallpaper to match the weather. Choose a Preview weather to try each one (it returns to Live after 2 minutes). Rain and snow fall in the real direction of the wind: with Real (compass) the drops follow the wind bearing from the forecast and your phone's compass and tilt, and raindrops on the glass slide the way gravity pulls. Without a compass sensor they fall north up (wind from the west blows to the right). In the Pure Black and Pure White looks they are drawn as plain white or black lines. They pause while the launcher is hidden and show one still frame with Reduce motion, Lite or the battery modes.
Lock home layout: icons cannot be dragged, moved or removed, and pages cannot be deleted. Adding apps still works. \u201cI choose the cell\u201d shows the free cells so you tap where a single app goes; adding several apps at once uses the first free cells.
Swipe left on the home screen to open widgets. Apps can add cards through the Android bridge.
At a glance & notifications
Badges, previews and now-playing need notification access. Next event needs calendar access. Commute is shown when an app sends it.
